claims.claimText: A method for component carrier (CC) deactivation in a user equipment (UE) of a wireless communication system, comprising: receiving a Radio Resource Control (RRC) message for configuring carrier aggregation (CA) to the UE; and flushing all uplink hybrid automatic repeat-request (HARQ) buffers of the HARQ entity corresponding to an uplink (UL) CC when a linked downlink (DL) CC which provides a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) scheduling for the UL CC is deactivated.
The method of claim 1, further comprising indicating in the RRC message a linkage between the DL CC and the said UL CC.
The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving on the DL CC a physical HARQ Indicator Channel (PHICH) used for HARQ feedback in response to transmission on the UL CC.
The method of claim 1, further comprising deactivating the DL CC due to reception of a Medium Access Control (MAC) control element or a timer-based implicit CC deactivation.
The method of any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the UL CC is an UL Secondary CC.
The method of any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the DL CC is a DL Secondary CC.
The method of claim 5, wherein the DL CC is a DL Secondary CC.

A user equipment (UE) for a wireless communication system, the UE comprising: a control circuit for realizing functions of the UE; a processor installed in the control circuit, for executing a program code to command the control circuit; and a memory installed in the control circuit and coupled to the processor; wherein the processor is configured to execute a program code stored in memory to receive a Radio Resource Control (RRC) message for configuring carrier aggregation (CA) to the UE, and flush all uplink hybrid automatic repeat-request (HARQ) buffers of the HARQ entity corresponding to an uplink (UL) CC when a linked downlink (DL) CC which provides a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) scheduling for the UL CC is deactivated.
The user equipment of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to execute the program code to further indicate in the RRC message a linkage between the DL CC and the said UL CC.

The user equipment of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to execute the program code to further receive on the DL CC a physical HARQ Indicator Channel (PHICH) used for HARQ feedback in response to transmission on the UL CC.

The user equipment of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to execute the program code to further deactivate the DL CC due to reception of a Medium Access Control (MAC) control element or a timer-based implicit CC deactivation.
The user equipment of any of claims 8 to 11, wherein the UL CC is an UL Secondary CC.
The user equipment of any of claims 8 to 11, wherein the DL CC is a DL Secondary CC.
The user equipment of claim 12, wherein the DL CC is a DL Secondary CC.
